svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 05 · Los Angeles · 01/12 Royce Hall (Legendary)
svg.desc: Two brick towers over the quad. Everyone takes the same photo from the lawn, and it is always worth it. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
